verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.
research_scope: Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack (Ultimate) — Ki Blast Ultimate.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies the Ultimate variant as a Ki Blast Ultimate costing 300 Ki, with projectile, ghost, long-range, 5-hit, and knockback characteristics.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack (Ultimate) is learned through Gotenks training; independent mentor-training documentation identifies it as the final Lesson 3 reward.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as null because this is a mentor-training reward and no Ultimate Finish condition is documented.
verification_audit.variant_policy: The Ultimate variant is kept distinct from Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack (Super), DUAL Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack, and Super Ghost Buu Attack.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage percentages are not promoted as canonical database values because observed damage can depend on character stats and version conditions.

records.name: Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack
records.skill_description: Create ultra-powerful ghosts behind your back and send them toward the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: The Ultimate variant creates five ghosts that launch one after another. Current Xenoverse 2 reference material describes the attack as a long-range projectile with five hits and knockback. It remains distinct from the one-ghost Super variant and the ten-ghost DUAL variant.
